name: @whs/game-bridge
description: Small, framework-independent postMessage bridge for WHS browser games

scripts.build: npm run build:sdk && npm run build:example
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && npm run build:sdk && tsc -p examples/mock-game/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build:sdk && tsc -p tsconfig.package-test.json && vitest run --exclude 'tests/browser/**'
